headline: Amazon advances AI agent integration with new tools and updates.

items.title: Announcing the OpenAI Safety Fellowship
items.summary: OpenAI has launched a pilot program called the Safety Fellowship to foster independent research in AI safety and alignment. This initiative aims to nurture emerging talent by providing resources and support for developing new safety techniques crucial for the responsible deployment of AI systems.
items.why_it_matters: Understanding and mitigating risks in AI systems is critical for developers creating AI-powered tools.

items.title: Accelerate agentic tool calling with serverless model customization in Amazon SageMaker AI
items.summary: Amazon has detailed a method to accelerate tool calling in AI systems by fine-tuning models using RLVR within SageMaker. This involves preparing datasets for distinct agent behaviors and designing reward functions to optimize performance. The approach promises more efficient and tailored AI agent operations.
items.why_it_matters: Enhanced tool-calling capabilities can significantly improve AI agent performance in real-world applications.

items.title: Build AI-powered employee onboarding agents with Amazon Quick
items.summary: Amazon introduces a guide to build custom HR onboarding agents using Amazon Quick. These agents can automate various tasks, like answering new-hire questions and managing document processes, by integrating with existing HR systems and understanding organizational workflows.

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI combines model families for a second opinion
items.summary: GitHub introduces a new feature in Copilot CLI, utilizing multiple model families to provide diverse perspectives during code review. This enhancement aims to improve code quality by integrating varied suggestions from different AI models.
items.source: The latest on AI & ML - The GitHub Blog

items.title: Toward Full Autonomous Laboratory Instrumentation Control with Large Language Models
items.summary: Research explores the use of large language models (LLMs) for automating the control of complex laboratory instruments, reducing the need for extensive programming expertise. This could democratize access to advanced lab equipment.

items.title: Show HN: Ghost Pepper – Local hold-to-talk speech-to-text for macOS
items.summary: Ghost Pepper is a newly released open-source, local voice-to-text application for macOS, ensuring user privacy by not transmitting data off-device. It's highly beneficial for developers seeking privacy-focused productivity tools.

all_items.title: Build AI-powered employee onboarding agents with Amazon Quick
all_items.summary: In this post, we walk through building a custom HR onboarding agent with Quick. We show how to configure an agent that understands your organization’s processes, connects to your HR systems, and automates common tasks, such as answering new-hire questions and tracking document completion.

all_items.title: Accelerate agentic tool calling with serverless model customization in Amazon SageMaker AI
all_items.summary: In this post, we walk through how we fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct for tool calling using RLVR. We cover dataset preparation across three distinct agent behaviors, reward function design with tiered scoring, training configuration and results interpretation, evaluation on held-out data with unseen tools, and deployment.

all_items.title: Building Intelligent Search with Amazon Bedrock and Amazon OpenSearch for hybrid RAG solutions
all_items.summary: In this post, we show how to implement a generative AI agentic assistant that uses both semantic and text-based search using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents and Amazon OpenSearch.

all_items.title: From isolated alerts to contextual intelligence: Agentic maritime anomaly analysis with generative AI
all_items.summary: This blog post demonstrates how Windward helps enhance and accelerate alert investigation processes by combining geospatial intelligence with generative AI, enabling analysts to focus on decision-making rather than data collection.

all_items.title: Connecting MCP servers to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway using Authorization Code flow
all_items.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway provides a centralized layer for managing how AI agents connect to tools and MCP servers across your organization. In this post, we walk through how to configure AgentCore Gateway to connect to an OAuth-protected MCP server using the Authorization Code flow.
